hook: council 會議，counsel 勸告／律師，consul 領事——會議室名牌印錯，三位客人走錯門。
script: council＝理事會。counsel＝建議或律師。consul＝領事。counselor 顧問。口令：開會寫 council，給建議寫 counsel，護照寫 consul。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 開會門: council walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「開會門」出場：council 一上場梗就黏住——理事會。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 建議門: counsel walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「建議門」出場：counsel 一上場梗就黏住——勸告律師。

members.senseAnchor: a diplomat appointed by a government to protect its commercial interests and help its citizens in a foreign country
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 護照門: consul walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「護照門」出場：consul 一上場梗就黏住——領事。

members.speakLineZh: 請「顧問牌」出場：consultancy 一上場梗就黏住——顧問業。
